tool_args.rationale: Fit the archived barrier-activated siphon numerically to the five paid observations, then test it on fresh confirmation. The observed sink-gradient variation provides leverage on inhibition.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed barrier-activation signature favors the archived barrier mechanism; fresh confirmation will test it.
The pilot spans sink gradients from 0.25 to 2.25, so the archive's narrow-gradient trigger does not apply; the five observations constrain the four-parameter static mechanism.
The pilot signatures favor a static barrier-siphon law rather than a coupled memory ODE.
